children: AGF Management reported a rise in third-quarter profit and revenue, driven by higher management fees and assets under management.

The asset management firm on Wednesday posted net income of 31.2 million Canadian dollars ($22.2 million), or C$0.48 a share, for the third quarter ended Aug. 31, up from C$28.4 million, or C$0.42 a share, in the comparable quarter a year ago.
Adjusted earnings were C$0.49 a share. According to FactSet, analysts were expecting C$0.58 a share.
Total adjusted net revenues rose to C$112.5 million from C$107.5 million. The company benefited from higher net management, advisory and administration fees of C$101 million, up from C$88.8 million.
Assets under management rose to C$74.2 billion, up from C$56.8 billion, and generated free cash flows of C$38.9 million, up 27%.
